question: Doflamingo kind of gives off the same feeling as Spiderman. Is this just me?
answer: I understand. However, Spiderman has only recently become popular in Japan, at least that's my impression. The look of Doflamingo's eyes is actually based on a look that was popular when I was in Kindergarten. I found an old picture I drew from those days of "Kamen Rider Super-1" and I think that is probably where I got my inspiration. I love the look of those eyes!!
name: Ebi
